hypothesis.hypothesis: Nine direct Isaac Sim renders of the accepted assembly USDC are sufficient for a human to review the modeled plug, receptacle, contact faces, rear geometry, default preassembly pose and an explicitly labeled static mated pose.
hypothesis.unique_change: Create an isolated read-only render script and a new multiview_v1 output directory; author camera, lights, visibility and static pose overrides only in the USD session layer.
hypothesis.expected_result: Nine 960x960 nonblank PNG files and one contact sheet are generated, the two requested part-number identities read back exactly, and the source USDC SHA-256 remains unchanged.
hypothesis.failure_criterion: Any expected view is missing or blank, identity/count readback fails, the source asset changes, the timeline starts, or a file outside j599_25_35_standard_interface_v1 is modified by this render task.
